object.description: Set a table on an object and look at the object file; empty an outline ref by moving or deleting its only child and look at the manifest. Expected: table at 2 spaces, columns at 4, col at 6; the emptied ref is written as <ref id="DOC-0"/> with no whitespace left inside it.
